tldr: The one direct-competitor item today is CIBC adding another U.S. Canadian Depositary Receipt (CDR) offering. The larger signals come from outside Canada: 24/7 tokenized trading at NYSE and Nubank, bank-issued stablecoins and tokenized deposits at SoFi, and AI/voice-first banking from Starling and Banco do Brasil.
themes: Stablecoins and tokenized deposits going mainstream
Everyday P2P and payments convenience (bill splitting, tap to pay)

highlights.headline: CIBC is launching an additional U.S. Canadian Depositary Receipt (CDR), extending its CDR program.
highlights.why: CIBC is the only direct Canadian competitor in today's items. CDRs give Canadian investors currency-hedged exposure to U.S. stocks, so Simplii's self-directed investing team should check what CDR access and coverage its own platform offers.

highlights.headline: NYSE affiliate plans to launch 24/7 tokenized stock trading this month, and Binance is opening 24/7 perpetual trading on Nubank.
highlights.why: Round-the-clock trading from a major exchange and a large digital bank is starting to set a new customer expectation. Simplii Direct Investing should look at its own hours and settlement roadmap.

highlights.headline: SoFi's SoFiUSD, billed as the first tokenized deposit product at a US bank, is now live on Polygon, its third blockchain. Separately, PNC is piloting stablecoin payments for corporate clients with Coinbase.
highlights.why: A digital-first bank is putting regulated tokenized money on public chains, and a large incumbent is accepting stablecoin payments. That makes stablecoin and tokenized-deposit strategy a live roadmap question for Canadian digital banks.

highlights.headline: Starling launched an AI 'talk to transact' feature that lets customers set up payments by speaking to the app. Banco do Brasil added voice calls inside its app and Itaú brought an AI assistant to its SME app.
highlights.why: Conversational and voice-first servicing is moving from pilot to shipped product across several banks, which raises the bar for app UX and AI assistance.
